## Review gates

- [ ] Product scope and acceptance scenarios are approved.
- [ ] Repository artifacts and recorded decisions are in English.
- [ ] No unresolved `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` remains.
- [ ] Constitution Check passes; exceptions are explicitly approved.
- [ ] `$speckit-analyze` has no unresolved CRITICAL findings.
- [ ] Requirement → scenario → task → test traceability is complete.
- [ ] Source → Evidence → Reality and shortest true links were reviewed.
- [ ] Tenant scope and shared service/tool boundaries were reviewed.
- [ ] Schema additions have a proven repeated core-logic use case.
- [ ] Important Web results/actions remain explainable through Inspect/trace.

## Verification

- [ ] Spec policy check
- [ ] Ruff
- [ ] PostgreSQL pytest suite
- [ ] Migration chain, when applicable
- [ ] Frontend build and i18n audit, when applicable
- [ ] Independent acceptance stories listed in the spec
